data.selection_policy: Choose every equal-cost candidate measurement maximizing expected reduction of target-state entropy after the currently observed evidence. Measurements reveal that candidate node state without additional measurement noise; neither candidate is already observed. Ties within1e-10bits include all candidates. Report both prior-information and evidence-conditioned-information values separately. Here information is Shannon mutual information in bits; I(T;M|E=e) sums p(t,m|e)*log2(p(t,m|e)/(p(t|e)*p(m|e))) over states,with zero-mass terms interpreted by their continuous limit. Before evidence,report I(T;M). The expectation is over the possible state of the next measurement,not the single most favorable result.
data.model_scope: Published WIN95PTS Bayesian-network benchmark probabilities for a technical diagnostic model,not newly observed printer trials or calibrated probabilities for a current device. The exported4-node subset is ancestral: all parents of AppData are included and the other3nodes are roots in the original model. All omitted descendants/unrelated nodes marginalize away when no evidence about them is supplied. Edges specify the supplied probabilistic factorization,not a validated real-world causal intervention model. Do not infer current Windows behavior,security weakness or a real-device recommendation.
